title: Lifecycle on load: claims, five-star candidates, private pods
description:
Every lifecycle key lands on the same-named Item field, nothing dropped or renamed; the load records its commit and writes one version per load (no Git replay). Pod review stamps load as claims shown as Recorded in the pod by <name>, not verified, and never satisfy a hard gate, a required checklist step, publishRequiresRating or a five-star rule; a person confirms once in the newsroom. A rating of 5 is refused on load and listed as a five-star candidate. A pod with no site folder is private: pod build refuses and pod load loads notes as private newsroom data at their stage; a load never publishes. Decision accepted by Ryan 2026-11-16: stamps are unverified claims and there is no stronger pod.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Lossless load (every key lands on the same-named field; commit recorded; loading twice writes nothing).
- Gherkin: A claim stays a claim.
- Gherkin: A pod never grants five stars.
- Gherkin: A pod with no site is private (pod build refuses; a load publishes nothing).

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.

comments.text: Follow-up merged to develop in #1691 (not released). Answer to the open question: a site pod's load now publishes a Story whose front matter says stage: published, through the site's normal publish step (placeholder-slug check, render preflight, publish_item, page-build trigger). Every publish rule still applies (open checklist, publishRequiresRating, approval); a refusal is reported for that note, the note stays a draft, nothing is forced. A note that does not say published stays unpublished; a private pod never publishes; an unchanged reload does nothing. The note is written at copywriting and only the publish step moves it to published, so a pod cannot skip the checklist. A refused publish is not retried by a reload of an unchanged file: change the file or publish in the newsroom. Specs: features_backend/pod-load-publish.feature (fakes only).
